name: Jarvan IV
notes: Opens with Cataclysm (R) targeted on the dummy at t=0; the 0.35 s leap travel time means its impact damage lands after Dragon Strike's cast, so it benefits from Dragon Strike's armor shred as the proposed rotation intends.
Dragon Strike (Q) is cast every time it comes off cooldown; its own hit is resolved before the armor shred is applied (per the wiki), so only later damage benefits from the reduced armor.
The armor-shred slot the engine reads takes one flat percent rather than a by-rank list, so Dragon Strike's rank-5 value (26%) is used, matching the level-16, max-rank Q assumed for this fight.

Demacian Standard (E) is cast every time it comes off cooldown, targeted on the dummy's location, for its magic damage; Jarvan is assumed to remain within the flag's aura range for its full 8 s duration, doubling his bonus attack speed from E (permanent passive + aura) while it is up, per the wiki's stated total.

Martial Cadence procs on every attack once its internal per-target cooldown (6s to 3s by level, 3s at level 16) is up; its bonus damage (8% of the target's current health, minimum 20) is snapshotted before the attack's own damage lands and skipped if the main hit kills the target, as the wiki specifies.
The 400 damage cap on Martial Cadence only applies against non-champion targets; the dummy counts as an enemy champion under the fight rules, so it is never capped here.
Golden Aegis (W) deals no damage and is never cast in this rotation; it is left at rank 1 or unranked as an ability point priority since it contributes nothing to the damage fight.
Cataclysm's cooldown starts on impact (post-effect) and it is recast on cooldown for its damage; the optional manual recast that only destroys the terrain adds no damage and is not used.
No ability here is stated to critically strike, so all ability and on-hit damage uses crit_mod = false.
Mana costs are not modeled; nothing here binds inside an 8-15 s fight at level 16.
